description: AlphaFold-based discrimination figure (pLDDT and core packing) and SGD abundance/expression evidence for LIH1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def af(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=90).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(r["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    res={}
    for line in pdb.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ATOM") and line[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            res[int(line[22:26])]=(float(line[60:66]),
                np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])]))
    idx=np.array(sorted(res)); return idx, np.array([res[i][0] for i in idx]), np.array([res[i][1] for i in idx])

T=[("P47145","LIH1 S. cerevisiae (query)",0,"#f59e0b"),
   ("E0A7J0","Lip2 Y. lipolytica, SP 1-17",17,"#2563eb"),
   ("O42807","FaeA A. niger, SP 1-21 (exp.)",21,"#0891b2"),
   ("P61870","MdlA P. camemberti, SP 1-26 (exp.)",26,"#7c3aed"),
   ("O59952","Lipase T. lanuginosus, SP 1-17",17,"#059669"),
   ("P25641","Atg15 S. cerevisiae, anchor 15-35",35,"#be123c")]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
rows=[]
for acc,lab,spend,c in T:
    idx,pl,xyz=af(acc)
    core=xyz[idx>80]
    cont=np.array([int((np.linalg.norm(core-xyz[i],axis=1)<10).sum()) for i in range(len(idx))])
    n=min(60,len(idx))
    lw = 2.6 if acc=="P47145" else 1.3
    axes[0].plot(idx[:n],pl[:n],color=c,lw=lw,label=lab)
    axes[1].plot(idx[:n],cont[:n],color=c,lw=lw)
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,label=lab,sp=spend,
                     plddt=pl[:25].mean(), ratio=cont[:25].mean()/cont[100:].mean()))
axes[0].axhline(70,ls=':',c='k',lw=1); axes[0].text(42,71.5,"pLDDT 70",fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("Residue"); axes[0].set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
axes[0].set_title("N-terminal model confidence",fontsize=11)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Residue"); axes[1].set_ylabel("C-alpha contacts with core (<10 A)")
axes[1].set_title("Is the N-terminus packed against the fold?",fontsize=11)

R=pd.DataFrame(rows)
ax=axes[2]
ax.scatter(R.plddt,R.ratio,s=[260 if a=="P47145" else 110 for a in R.acc],
           c=[t[3] for t in T],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.7,
           marker='o',zorder=3)
for _,r in R.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r.label.split(",")[0],(r.plddt,r.ratio),fontsize=8,
                xytext=(5,5),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvspan(35,62,color='#fee2e2',alpha=.6)
ax.text(48,0.26,"signal-bearing\nproteins",fontsize=8,ha='center',color='#b91c1c')
ax.set_xlabel("mean pLDDT, residues 1-25"); ax.set_ylabel("N-terminal / core contact ratio")
ax.set_title("LIH1 separates from all five signal controls",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(R.round(3).to_string(index=False))

# protein abundance / expression evidence
h={"User-Agent":"openscientist"}
for ep in ["protein_abundance_details","expression_details","interaction_details"]:
    try:
        r=requests.get(f"https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/S000003868/{ep}",timeout=60,headers=h)
        d=r.json(); print(f"\n{ep}: status {r.status_code}, n={len(d) if isinstance(d,list) else 'dict'}")
        if isinstance(d,list) and d:
            import json as js
            for x in d[:6]: print("   ", js.dumps(x)[:320])
    except Exception as e: print(ep,"ERR",e)
